notes: Waves last twice as long: twice as many foes, each with half the health and worth half the gold, so a wave is just as hard and pays the same.
Foes arrive in clumps with short pauses in between. Halfway through each wave you get half of the wave-clear gold.
Lantern mastery earns half a point per kill, so the extra foes don’t speed it up.
Pass tiers now cost a little more as you climb: 100 XP for tier 1, then 1 more each tier, up to 199 for tier 100.
